x-groups.title: Connection
x-groups.description: The server, and the user the source signs in as.

x-groups.title: Tables
x-groups.description: What the source offers as streams.

x-groups.title: Tuning
x-groups.description: How much a read asks of the server at a time.

addr.title: Address
addr.description: host:port of the server's native protocol: 9000, or 9440 with TLS.

tls.title: TLS
tls.description: Connect with TLS, verified against the system's roots, as the secure native port, 9440, needs.

database.title: Database
database.description: The database whose tables are offered as streams.

tables.title: Tables
tables.description: The tables to offer as streams. Empty: every table and view in the database but materialized views, whose rows are in their target tables.

chunkRows.title: Rows per chunk
chunkRows.description: Rows per query on a table read in sorting-key order; each chunk ends at a resume point.

maxConnections.title: Most connections
maxConnections.description: The most connections a read holds, as many as it has lanes up to this.
